notes.title: Hotfix - Vive Wands and Valve Index Controllers Now Visible in Tutorial
notes.content:
Fixes

 Vive Wands and Valve Index Controllers should now show up properly in the in-game tutorials
 Note: full remapping functionality for both the Vive Wands and Valve Index Contollers is being investigated for a future fix

notes.title: Steam VR Update
notes.content:
Support for Vive headsets and controllers (note: future updates will show more controller types in the tutorials and allow more controller options for the Vive wand controllers)
 Better support for joining lobbies via friends list
 Fixed rare crashes
 Audio fixes
